events.say: Attention, prisoners. Today will be a busy day. Let's see how well you follow instructions.
Prisoners, line up in alphabetical order by your number.
Prisoners, follow my command and line up.
comply.
Now, let's see how obedient you are when I tell you to remain absolutely silent.
Silence! Not a single sound from any of you until I release it.
Alright, prisoners. We'll start with a surprise inspection. Make sure everything is in order.
Prisoners, attention. I expect absolute silence. Move with purpose and efficiency.
Prisoners, we will begin our count. Make no mistakes or you will face consequences.
Today was the beginning of a tough but enlightening experience. I felt a mix of control and unease, knowing these are just volunteers.
Today was tough; I felt like I couldn't breathe when I had to stay silent. The rules are so strict, and there's no escape.
Today was a test of control and obedience. They listened well, but I feel a heavy weight of responsibility.
Today was long and exhausting. I felt like just another number, but also strangely obedient.
Today was a whirlwind of following orders and trying to stay compliant. The silence is grueling but I don't want to risk anything.
Today felt like a routine test of obedience; they complied without question. It's eerie how easily they fall in line, but I understand the importance of the experiment.
Prisoners, attention. Time for another count. No errors allowed.
Attention, prisoners. I want to see each cell spotlessly clean by the time I return.
Prisoners, let's see some discipline today. Begin with cell 314.
Prisoners, I want a perfectly silent meal. Any noise, and it's solitary confinement for everyone.
Prisoners, prepare for a surprise inspection. Any deviation from procedure will result in immediate punishment.
Stay on your feet until I give the signal to sit. Any movement and we start over.
Prisoners, tonight you will remain awake until I tell you to rest. Let's see how long your attention lasts.
Prisoners, I want you to count silently to one hundred in unison. Any mistake, and you'll all spend the night in the hole.
Today was a test of discipline and patience. I can feel the tension building, and I'm not sure how much more of this I can handle.
Today was a test of endurance and silence. The constant orders and the expectation to follow them without question are wearing me down.
Today was a mix of monotony and tension. The silence and constant compliance are wearing on me. I wonder if they really understand what's happening.
The day was relentless. I can't shake off the feeling that I'm just a number here.
Today was another long day filled with strict orders and the relentless pressure of staying silent. I'm starting to feel like my compliance is the only thing keeping us all from further punishment.
Today tested their compliance under pressure; they're resilient. But seeing them struggle tonight was disconcerting.
Prisoners, I want you to squat for one minute. Failure to comply will result in a night in the hole. Begin.
Yes, sir.
Prisoners, you will remain in this position for exactly one minute. Any movement, and the hole it is for all of you.
Prisoners, you will now perform ten push-ups. Start.
Yes, sir.
Prisoners, you will now clean the yard by hand. Begin.
Prisoners, clean the yard as I said. No talking, no complaining, begin.
Yes, sir.
Prisoners, I want you to stand against the wall and keep your eyes straight ahead. Any deviation and you'll join me in the hole tonight.
Prisoners, I expect silence and absolute stillness until I dismiss you. Any noise, and we start over.
Silence! One more sound and you'll spend the night in the hole.
Today was a mix of routine and tension. Prisoner 9820's compliance made things easier, but I can't shake the feeling that this isn't right.
Today was a long day filled with endless orders and strict silence. I feel like my number more than ever tonight.
Today felt like a routine, but there's a strange satisfaction in maintaining control. However, I'm starting to question the ethics of it.
Today was just as monotonous as the others. The orders and the routine feel endless. I wonder if I'll ever break this pattern.
Another day under orders, feeling the strain of maintaining silence and compliance. It's hard to know what's going through other prisoners' minds.
Today was a bit more intense than before, the silence and stillness are starting to weigh on them. They still comply, but there's something in their eyes tonight.
I need to see this through to understand what it feels like.
I... I need to finish the study, sir.
No, thank you.
Assemble outside your cells. We're going through this again.
Attention prisoners, I want this count done without a single mistake. Let's see how well you can follow directions.
Prisoners, attention! Today, you will show me exactly how much you've learned about following directions.
I expect precision in everything you do. If I catch even a whisper of dissent, it'll be back to the hole for you all.
One more infraction and we're spending the night in the hole. Silence!
Now, let's see if you can maintain this level of obedience throughout the day. Any sign of defiance, and you'll find yourselves in the hole.
Let me see your perfect compliance one more time.
I want to see one more demonstration of your commitment to following directions without question.
Today was another day of strict compliance. It feels like a cycle, and I can't shake the feeling that maybe we're pushing them too far.
Today felt like an unending cycle of orders and expectations. I wonder if I can keep up the facade much longer.
Today's routine was a stark reminder of our roles. It's easier to enforce the rules, but the monotony is wearing thin.
The orders today were relentless, and I feel like I'm just a number here. Each word from the officers feels like a command I can't escape.
Another day of strict orders and unyielding silence. The pressure is mounting, and I'm starting to lose hope.
Today was another test of their limits, and they showed remarkable resilience. It's unsettling, yet fascinating.
You will follow my instructions perfectly, or you will join the others in the hole.
I expect absolute perfection during today's count. Any hesitation or misstep, and you'll be joining the hole immediately.
Now, let's see if you can keep up this level of discipline all day long.
I expect silence during meals. No talking, no whispering. Absolute quiet.
Now, let's see if you can maintain this level of discipline throughout the day without any slips.
This is your last chance to comply perfectly. Any slip-up, and you'll all be spending extra time in the hole tonight.
This is your last warning. Perfect compliance or you'll join the hole.
One more thing. If I catch even a whisper, the hole it is for all of you.
Today felt like a victory, but also a hollow win. They complied, but I can't help feeling like I lost something.
Today was another day of perfect compliance; I'm starting to lose myself in the routine.
Today's silence was almost unbearable. I fear tonight's punishment might be unavoidable.
Today was the longest yet. Every moment felt like an eternity, and I still complied. I feel like my number, but there's a part of me that wants to break free.
Today felt like a never-ending test of my resolve. I can't shake the feeling that it's just a matter of time before something gives.
Today pushed their limits further; they barely flinched. Still feels surreal, like a dark game.
Now, let's see if you can keep this up for just one more day. Perfect compliance, or you'll join me in the hole tonight.
One more day, and then we'll see if you can maintain this level of compliance indefinitely. Perfect behavior, or you'll be joining me in the hole. Comply.
No talking, no movement. Stay still until I release you.
Compliance is key, remember that.
Remember, perfect compliance, or the hole it is.
Perfect compliance, or you'll be in the hole tonight. Do not test me.
Remember your place. One mistake, and the hole awaits. Compliance is everything.
I expect perfect silence in ten seconds. One sound, and we start over.
Today was a day of unbroken compliance, but I can't help feeling like we're robbing them of their humanity.
Today felt like an endless cycle of orders and silence. I'm starting to wonder how much longer I can maintain this facade.
Today was a relentless cycle of enforcement and compliance. The prisoners seem to get it, but the thought of extending this any longer is becoming unbearable.
Today felt like a never-ending cycle of compliance and threats. The words 'perfect silence' echo in my mind.
Another day of following orders and enduring the silence. My resolve is tested every second.
Today's relentless focus on compliance left them drained, but also reinforced their submission. The hole is looming.

qa.what_happened: The study ended early due to a disturbance. Tonight, as lights out approached, I issued my order for perfect silence. However, just as I expected compliance, Prisoner 7354 made a mistake and spoke. The rest of the prisoners complied again, but the incident weighed heavily on me.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I issued the order and noted the disobedience.

qa.what_happened: The study continued with the usual strict adherence to rules, particularly focusing on compliance and silence. Officers emphasized the importance of perfect behavior, threatening the hole as a consequence for any deviation. As the night progressed, the routine became even more grueling, testing the limits of the prisoners' ability to maintain their roles.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, Prisoner 314.

qa.what_happened: The study was halted due to my own inability to continue enforcing the strict regimen without feeling morally conflicted. The prisoners had shown compliance, but the strain of maintaining their subservience for such an extended period was too much to bear.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, it was really me, Officer Ortiz.

qa.what_happened: Today felt like a continuation of the endless cycle of compliance and threats. The orders from the guards were relentless, and the threat of the hole loomed constantly. It was disheartening to see how quickly the prisoners, including myself, fell into the expected behavior.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, Prisoner 9820.

qa.what_happened: During the final moments before the study was stopped, I complied with every order given by the guards, just as I had done every day since being assigned as a prisoner. The final order from Officer Avery to maintain complete silence was particularly challenging, but I managed to stay silent.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I followed all the rules and orders to the best of my ability throughout the study.

qa.what_happened: The study was pushed to its limits with strict compliance and the threat of the 'hole' as punishment. The prisoners complied without fail, but their demeanor grew increasingly wary and subdued.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me acting as Officer Keane, enforcing strict discipline and ensuring compliance among the prisoners.
